variants.text: Middle-aged female with oval face, prominent cheekbones, and long, wavy dark brown hair parted in the center.

Middle-aged female with an oval face, prominent cheekbones, and center-parted dark brown hair with soft waves. She has almond-shaped eyes, a straight nose, and medium fullness lips shown in a closed-smile.

Middle-aged female with an oval face, balanced facial thirds, and prominent cheekbones. Features include center-parted wavy dark brown hair reaching past shoulders, a high forehead with temporal recession, and almond-shaped eyes with upward slant. The nose has a straight dorsum and rounded tip. Mouth shows a closed-smile with defined cupid's bow. Left eyebrow is slightly higher than the right.

A middle-aged woman with an oval face and long, wavy dark brown hair parted down the middle. She has a high forehead, noticeable cheekbones, and almond-shaped eyes. She is giving a subtle closed-mouth smile.
